answer_2.quote: We evaluated the models, using the following three metrics: (1) Perplexity (PPL) ... (2) Distinct-n (Dist-n) ... (3) We use BERTscore (F BERT ) ...

answer_4.quote: We randomly sampled 100 test dialogues and asked 3 human workers to score models' generated responses on 1 to 5 point scale, following the four metrics
answer_4.guideline: following the four metrics: (1) Empathy measures whether the generated response understands the speaker's emotion and situation. (2) Relevance measures whether the generated response is coherent to the context. (3) Fluency measures whether the generated response is grammatically correct and readable. (4) Diversity to measure whether the generated response is non-generic.
